verdict.rationale: Smithery documents service tokens built to expose it to AI agents without leaking the main API key. The tokens are scoped to specific permissions and resources: the documented example can only list and call tools on connections in one namespace matching `metadata.userId`, and nothing else. API keys can also be scoped to namespaces. Missing for 10: documented token expiry/TTL and revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping behavior.
